sentences.en: Please tell me the requirements for admission to the college.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我进入这所大学的要求。

sentences.en: The standards for admission to this school are very high.
sentences.zh: 这所学校录取的标准非常高。

sentences.en: Our university authorities are considering the admission of handicapped students.
sentences.zh: 我们的校方正在考虑招收残疾学生。

senses.zh: 准许进入 - 入场费, 入场券 - 承认, 供认 形容词: admissive
